title: Desert theme and Spike helper
summary: Refreshed MyAPES Account with a warmer desert visual system and introduced Spike, a cartoon bearded dragon who offers short operational tips on key pages.
changes: Updated light and dark colour tokens, sidebar, canvas texture, and browser theme colour to a sun-baked sand, sage, and clay palette while keeping teal as the accessible oasis accent.
Replaced the photorealistic bearded dragon portrait with cartoon Spike artwork on landing, staff sign-in, and the dashboard identity card.
Added reusable Spike tip callouts, a dismissible page-keyed helper dock, and operational copy for first-run, dashboard, and service list pages.
affected_areas: Shared visual theme, mascot artwork, dashboard, landing and authentication pages, and in-page help copy
version_rationale: A backward-compatible minor release adding the cartoon mascot helper and desert visual system without changing workflows, data, or authorization.
validation: Theme, changelog, health, rollback-manifest, and mascot helper tests cover the refreshed interface, release record, and dismissible tip markup.
known_limitations: Spike tips are static page copy. They are not a chatbot and do not change authorization, records, or module availability.
No database migration is included. Theme choice remains a local browser preference.
rollback: Revert this release record, VERSION, runtime manifest version, theme, mascot, and helper files. No database rollback is needed.
provenance: Defined by the desert theme and cartoon mascot helper work for MyAPES Account issue #47.
